question: Who among the following scripted history as he became the youngest ever test captain as of September 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rashid Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Rashid Khan** became the youngest ever Test captain in cricket history as of September 2019.
 
• He achieved this milestone at the age of **20 years and 350 days**.
 
• Rashid Khan is an **Afghan cricketer** known for his exceptional leg-spin bowling skills.
 
• He led the Afghanistan national cricket team against Bangladesh in a one-off Test match in September 2019.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Test Cricket:**

 
 
• Test cricket is the longest form of the sport of cricket and is considered its highest standard.
 
• It is played between teams representing their countries over a period of up to five days.
 
• A Test match consists of four innings (two per team), and it requires a high level of skill and endurance.
 
 
 
• **Captaincy in Cricket:**
 
 
• The captain is the leader of the team both on and off the field.
 
 
• **Leg-Spin Bowling:**
 
 
• Leg-spin is a type of bowling in cricket where the ball spins from the leg side to the off side for a right-handed batsman.
 
• It is considered one of the most difficult bowling techniques to master due to the wrist action involved.
 
• Rashid Khan is renowned for his leg-spin, which has made him a key player in various T20 leagues around the world.
 
 
 
• **Afghanistan National Cricket Team:**
 
 
• The Afghanistan national cricket team represents Afghanistan in international cricket.
 
• The team has made significant progress since gaining Full Member status of the International Cricket Council (ICC) in 2017.
 
• Afghanistan is known for producing talented cricketers who have excelled in various formats of the game.
